text:
alex: Heads up — observed GPU capacity constraints in us-west1 for L4 and H100 yesterday evening. Getting OOMs on serving clusters; need quota bump + project approval for a temporary reserve. Project: redwood-inference-usw-prod-2. Need 8 x A100 (40GB) + 24 x L4 for canary fleet, plus 4 static external IPs for NAT. Anyone able to file the GCP quota request and ping the account team?

maria: Adding context — traffic spike from EU routed to us-west1 due to region failover. We tried autoscale but new nodes didn’t start (quota errors). Error in nodepool logs: "Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded". :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

jon: I can submit but need the billing contact and estimated sustained vGPU hours per month. Alex, what daily hours are you projecting?

alex: Expect ~2000 vGPU-hours for A100 and ~7200 vGPU-hours for L4 over next 30 days. Budget ok for short-term; if sustained we should switch to reserved commits. Billing contact: billing+infra@redwood.ai

lia: Also confirm whether we need VPC peering / static routes — network team flagged we might hit regional static IP quota and forwarding rules. How many external IPs exactly?

alex: 4 static external IPs. Also request increase to regional forwarding rules by +6. Need project-level approval for H100 usage as well (service account scopes).

jon: Drafted quota request payload, pasting quick gcloud snippet for record and to attach to ticket: 
```
gcloud compute regions quotas update us-west1 \
  --project=redwood-inference-usw-prod-2 \
  --quotas=GPUS_A100_40GB:8,GPUS_L4:24,STATIC_ADDRESSES:4,FORWARDING_RULES:6
```
Submitting now. @deploy-bot can you create an internal ticket and add GCP request id when available?

deploy-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-4278. GCP request ID: Q-2026-05-12-4892. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference-usw-prod-2

maria: Pinging our GCP account manager to expedite approval and verifying quotas in nearby regions as fallback. @alex please add workload runbook and SLO targets to the ticket so they understand the impact.

alex: Done — attached runbook, expected P95 latency and failover plan. Also added cost justification and commit preference in the ticket.

lia: Network asked for a brief VPC peering diagram and whether Private Service Connect is acceptable instead of peering. Sharing diagram in thread now. :thumbsup:

jon: Note — even after quota is approved we’ll need IAM permission changes so ops-runner SA can create H100 instances. I’ll coordinate a short maintenance window for the rollout.

alex: Thanks everyone. If approvals take >48h we’ll fallback to eu-west1 L4 pools and expand caching to reduce burst.

deploy-bot: Quota request status: PENDING (last updated 2026-05-12T18:14:22Z)
